tools.name: find_store
tools.description: Find online stores in Brazil that sell on DMCommerce, by store name or by what they sell (e.g. "jeans", "suplementos", "acessórios 4x4"). Leave query empty to list every store. Returns up to 20 stores with their website and main categories.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search products for sale in DMCommerce stores (Brazil), across every store or in one store. Returns up to 10 products with price in BRL, whether it is in stock, the store and the product link.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product of a DMCommerce store: description, every option (size, color...) with its price in BRL and whether it is available, and the link that opens that option on the store website.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Quote shipping for a product option to a Brazilian postal code (CEP), with the same options and prices the store checkout shows: carrier, price in BRL and delivery time in business days. Nothing is reserved or bought.
